 Competition Eligibility
 Answer these four questions to determine your eligibility.
 Are you either a citizen of the United States, a permanent resident or legally able to receive taxable income in the U.S. (i.e., have a social security number, ITIN, etc.) at the time of applying? Select an option Yes No 
 As of December 1, 2026, will you be in grade 10, 11 or 12? Select an option Yes No 
 As of December 1, 2026, will you be age 15-18? Select an option Yes No 
 If you are selected as an award winner with distinction, would this be your first time attending National YoungArts Week? Select an option Yes No 
 You're eligible to apply! Click here to get started. 
 We're sorry, but you're not eligible to apply. Reason(s): 
 You must be a citizen of the United States, a permanent resident or legally able to receive taxable income in the U.S. (i.e., have a social security number, ITIN, etc.) at the time of applying.
 You must be either (1) in grades 10-12, or (2) ages 15-18 as of December 1, 2026.
 If you are selected as an award winner with distinction, this must be your first time attending National YoungArts Week.
 Submit 
 What's New in 2027
 The 2027 YoungArts application will close on  Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 8 PM ET . We encourage artists to note this deadline carefully and submit their applications early.
 Application requirements across disciplines and categories are updated annually. Find all requirements  here , and be sure to review them thoroughly before submitting your application.
 The application platform has changed.
 If this is your first time applying, or if you’ve never received a YoungArts award,  click here to access the application portal. On the application portal, click ‘Log in’ in the top right corner. Once there, click ‘Register Here’ to create a new account. Or, simply click the ‘Register Here to Apply’ button on the discipline/category page of your choosing.
 If you are a recent award winner re-applying,  follow these instructions  to retrieve your password.
 Why Apply?
 Cash awards
 All YoungArts award winners receive cash prizes between $250 and $10,000. 
 Mentorship by accomplished artists
 We provide mentorship opportunities with accomplished artists to help award winners prepare for and navigate a career in the arts. 
 A lifetime of creative and professional support
 YoungArts is more than an award. Artists access resources and opportunities at every stage of their development to support a sustainable practice. 
 A robust network
 YoungArts award winners join a community of distinguished artists that provides a long – term, robust network to help artists at all stages of their education and career. 
 National recognition   
 The prestigious award gives emerging artists a headstart by demonstrating that they have received national recognition from highly respected artists in their field early on in their artistic journey.
